title: v0.9.0's RTX 5090 pre-acceptance probes on the adopted DFlash2 BF16 profile: every functional probe passes, the written refused-0 rule fails as v0.9.0 would, and free-form reasoning decodes 21-27% slower with two requests in flight
question: Does the DFlash2 K=7 two-request profile with BF16 KV and the durable store (the profile the founder chose to adopt after EXP-085 and EXP-088) pass the probes v0.9.0 qualified its RTX 5090 profile with: the profile gates, the two-requests-in-flight matrix and a restart during decode, fanout at 57K and 67K with restarts, warm arrival, and the shared-prefix agent mix?
answer: Every probe exited 0 and every scenario reported ok. 130,048-token retrieval was exact in 58.4 s (v0.9.0: 58.4 s), the agent protocol passed across a restart, near_capacity's two 125,879-token requests completed by taking turns as v0.9.0's did, fanout and warm arrival matched or beat v0.9.0, and 0 of 24 fresh agent sessions went to root. The rule as written fails on one clause: it required every shutdown to refuse 0 saves, and the concurrency matrix's stop refused 6, where v0.9.0's documented stop after the same probe refused 7. Beside the rule, two costs appeared. Free-form reasoning text decoded 2-5% slower than MTP3 at one request and 21-27% slower with two requests (207.5-222.1 against 281.1-283.0 tok/s together): DFlash2 drafts only 2.46-2.65 tokens per round there against MTP3's 2.27-2.39, while a two-request round costs 23.1 ms against 15.6 ms. And in the restart probe one of two stored sessions resumed from root (first output 27.0 s against v0.9.0's 5.5 s).

decision.action: Report; the founder chose to continue to the release candidate (2026-10-01T16:20Z) with these costs visible
decision.rule: Pre-registered in ~/.cache/omp-ninfer-v080-scratch/exp086/PLAN.md before EXP-085's verdict, retargeted to this arm at 15:32Z before the window: pass only if (a) the profile gates pass with exact retrieval and the post-restart 404; (b) every c2probe scenario and repeat is ok; (c) the restart probe is ok with both stored sessions resumed; (d) fanout-57k, fanout-67k and warm-arrival exit 0; (e) the agent mix exits 0 with no measured fresh session at root; (f) no server error in any request log and every shutdown ends 'refused 0'.
decision.verdict: fail on (f) as written: the c2probe stop refused 6 saves. (a)-(e) pass.
decision.deviation: (f)'s refused-0 clause was written without checking v0.9.0's evidence, whose stop after the same probe refused 7 ('checkpoints remain best effort; after the concurrency probe's evictions, stop refused 7 saves at two requests'). The failure is the rule's, not a regression; it is reported as a fail and not reinterpreted.
decision.not_decided_here: Whether the reasoning-text slowdown and the restart-reuse loss are acceptable for the release. The v0.10.0 candidate's qualification window measures the restart three times.

method.appliance: RTX 5090 (32,607 MiB), Windows 11, Docker Desktop, WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04; one arm on 127.0.0.1:18099 with production stopped
method.window: Windows lane hold taken; exp086-window.sh ran detached with a 180-minute dead-man; production stopped 15:32:37Z and restored healthy 15:59:50Z (27 min); dead-man cancelled; the arm's checkpoint root removed; hold released with production /health 200 from Windows.
method.arm: spk5-df2k7-c2ds2-ckpt: image ninfer-5090:008a7781-dflash2-nvfp4, server c260dde9, artifact 0634abb0; DFlash2 K=7 with the optimized LM head, BF16 KV, two requests, two device state slots, 24 host state slots, 16 GiB host KV, durable store on (24 GiB quota), keep-warm 60 s; EXP-083's arguments on this binary
method.baseline: v0.9.0's release evidence for the same probes (releases/v0.9.0/qualification/rtx5090.json and its window receipts)

profile.agent_protocol: passed: two forks, parent delete 200, deleted continuation 404 before and after the restart, no resurrection, surviving descendant and live sibling continued

reasoning_round_economics.source: request logs of both windows' c2probe short-prompt requests (1,024 reasoning tokens each)
reasoning_round_economics.role_corpus_reference: on the role corpus DFlash2 drafts 4.4-4.6 tokens per round against MTP3's 3.34 and decodes 17-21% faster (EXP-081, EXP-085)

c2restart.note: Both windows lost one interrupted continuation's reuse before the restart. After it, v0.9.0 restored both sessions from checkpoints; here session D1 re-prefilled from root and D2's restore waited behind it.

fanout_and_warm_arrival.warm_arrival: both orders: control and restored retrieval exact, every post-restart fork hot; resume-first restore plus sequence 4.41 s (v0.9.0: 5.64 s)

logs.c2probe_stop: saved 1, nothing to save 3, refused 6 (v0.9.0 after the same probe: refused 7)

limits: One window, two repeats of each c2probe scenario and one restart repeat; the restart-reuse loss is one observation.
The binary is the spike's incremental archive build (source_dirty=true), not the release candidate.
v0.9.0's numbers are its release evidence from 2026-09-29 on the same appliance, not reruns in this window.
